description: This file defines the IMiracastPlayer interface in the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace, including enums, data structures, and method signatures for Miracast player control and notifications.

classes.name: IMiracastPlayer
classes.description: Interface for Miracast player control, including states, reason codes, device parameters, video rectangle, result, environment arguments, and notification callbacks.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for Miracast player events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: PlayRequest
methods.description: Starts Miracast playback with specified device parameters and video rectangle.

methods.name: StopRequest
methods.description: Stops the Miracast playback for a specified client device.

methods.name: SetVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video rectangle for Miracast playback.
